name: Kaneshiro Kiyoka
source:
Married for two years.

Wife of Koutaruo's older brother, Taiyo, and youngest daughter of Mami Kaneshiro, president of Kaneyu Co.

Since there are two older brothers above her, the succession is left to them, She was raised in a relaxed, easygoing, and calm manner.

Perhaps because of this, she has never learned to doubt anyone, she innocently believes the words of Taiyo, who approached her for his own ambition.

In fact, in less than two years of marriage, she has been betrayed many times. Even so, she never stops loving him, a spirit of endless generosity and charity.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=540985&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
